title: Studio: drop the externalSharingModel dial and the Ext badge (objectui#12353)
body:
Fixes #12353
Clause-②: no

`@objectstack/spec` retires `externalSharingModel` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23268, ruling `6159300530`, letter A, item 4). This removes Studio's half: the external sharing dial, its D11 "external wider than internal" check, and the `Ext` badge.

## What changes

- **Object Settings tab** (`ObjectSettingsPanel`): the external dial (`owd-external-select`) and its warning line (`owd-external-desc`) are gone. The sharing-model dial is the only OWD control.
- **Package OWD overview** (`PackageOwdOverviewPanel`): the External column, the per-row D11 error, the D11 banner and the Save block it drove are gone. A row's load no longer reads the key, and its save no longer sets or deletes it. A `controlled_by_parent` row's master link moves from the old External cell to under the row's dial.
- **Permission-set matrix** (`PermissionMatrixEditor`): the `Ext` badge and the `owdExternal` read that fed it are gone.
- `owd-sharing.ts`: `isExternalWider` and `OWD_WIDTH` are removed (nothing else used them).
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the 8 keys that labelled the dial, column, badge and D11 messages are removed from both the en and zh tables (16 rows). Three strings that named the external half are reworded: `owd.description`, `owd.colInternal` (now "Sharing model"), and `owd.masterTip`.
- `publicSharing` is untouched (ruling item 3).

## Measurements

- **The installed spec treats the key as optional, so leaving it out cannot fail a save.** On `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.0` (the installed pin), `ObjectSchema.shape.externalSharingModel.isOptional()` is `true`. `ObjectSchema.safeParse` of a minimal object succeeds both with and without the key. That is why this lands now and does not wait for the spec PR.
- **Nothing a published export names is removed.** `@object-ui/app-shell` publishes `.` (`dist/index.js`) and `./styles.css`. `src/index.ts` exports nothing from `owd-sharing.ts`, `ObjectSettingsPanel`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel`, `PermissionMatrixEditor` or `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. `isExternalWider` and `OWD_WIDTH` were module-internal. What does change is the UI that the exported `StudioDesignSurface` renders: one control fewer. So the claim's `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **What a save does with a stored key: Studio keeps it and does not migrate it.** Both save paths re-send the whole document they read. The Settings tab's `onPatch` merges into the loaded draft, and the overview saves `{ ...(draft ?? baseline) }`. I ran a throwaway probe (not committed) on the new overview, with a stored `{ sharingModel: 'public_read', externalSharingModel: 'private' }` and a pick of Private. It saved `{"name":"p","label":"P","sharingModel":"private","externalSharingModel":"private"}`. So a stored key stays in the document until the author deletes it. Studio no longer names the key anywhere, and a delete-on-save would be a migration the card does not ask for. Once the spec PR lands, the spec's own refusal ("delete the key") is what the author sees. The open question is in the report.

## Tests

- Deleted: `ObjectSettingsPanel.owdAgreement.test.tsx`. It only pinned that the two surfaces agree on the D11 verdict, and that verdict no longer exists.
- Trimmed: the external rows and cases in `ObjectSettingsPanel.test.tsx`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.test.tsx`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765.test.tsx`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.scope.test.tsx` and `owd-sharing.test.ts`. The fixtures no longer carry the key.
- Absence pin, on one surface: `ObjectSettingsPanel.test.tsx` › "no external OWD dial (objectui#12353)". It renders an object that stores the key and checks four things: no external dial, no D11 line, no `externalSharingModel` text, and a sharing-model pick that patches `{ sharingModel }` alone.

**Not measured: the full `packages/app-shell/` project.** The shared verify lock was held throughout by another worktree's full app-shell run (pid 29792, live and progressing). Three acquisitions of 9 minutes each never got the lock. The local run is narrowed to the 32 files above, and CI runs all 12 shards.

## Acceptance notes

- `git grep externalSharingModel` outside CHANGELOGs now hits only the absence pin and a single doc line in `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` that says why the column is gone. On `origin/main` the same grep hit 13 files: 6 source and 7 test. This PR touches all 13, plus 2 test files the grep could not see. `owd-sharing.test.ts` pinned `isExternalWider` without spelling the key, and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.test.tsx` pinned the D11 block through test ids. That makes 9 test files, the count the ruling names.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 on this branch with "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field". The dispatch records this as a known failure on `main` (objectui#12334). I did not re-measure it on `main`. This diff touches no `package.json`.
